headline: Ilie Bolojan Adjusts His Message: In My View, Pensions and Salaries Should Be Indexed
summary: Interim Prime Minister Ilie Bolojan said pensions and salaries should be indexed and that budget restrictions should end next year. He said raising them would be difficult without a salary law.
why: Pension and wage indexation affects public spending, the budget deficit and inflation expectations, which matter for Romanian government bonds.
